LAW AND MOTION 301, PLAINTIFFS ROBERT HOLLAND, AND DENISE L. HOLLAND'S MOTION FOR SUMMARY JUDGMENT AGAINST CLAIMANT TO RIGHT OF POSSESSION MARK MITCHELTREE IS GRANTED. THE PLAINTIFF HAS ESTABLISHED THAT MR. MITCHELTREE'S RESIDENCE OR TENANCY IS NOT THROUGH THE PLAINTIFF AND WHATEVER RIGHTS HE MAY ACQUIRE AGAINST MR. DAS IS NOT WITH THE APPROVAL OF THE LANDLORD. THIS WAS CONTRARY TO THE RESTRICTION IMPOSED ON MR. DAS BY THE LANDLORD AND THEREFORE PLAINTIFF IS ENTITLED TO POSSESSION AGAINST MR. MITCHELTREE. CLAIM IS DENIED. PREVAILING PARTY IS TO PREPARE A FORM OF ORDER. JUDGE: PETER J. BUSCH, REPORTER: CAROL KAREN, CSR# 8189
